newsitem.title: USA: U S West sees no further cable TV buys.
newsitem.headline: U S West sees no further cable TV buys.

text.p: U S West Inc on Wednesday said it has no plans to buy more cable television properties, although it may under some circumstances trade properties to improve its portfolio.
"We've pretty much got enough on our plate," said Richard McCormick, Chief Executive of U S West Inc.
The company is divided into two tracking stocks, U S West Media Group, which includes the cable TV properties, and U S West Communciations Inc, which is a telephone company.

U S West Media is the third largest U.S. cable TV company. And it is anxious to avoid getting into the same debt problem as Time Warner Inc, with which it has a long-running dispute about a jointly-owned entertainment company.
"You will not see us falling on their debt grenade," McCormick said.
McCormick said that the company considered spinning off the media group late in 1995 but decided against it.
"(U S West) Media wasn't ready. But it is a question we will continually visit," McCormick said.
"I want these businesses to be strong...and stand on their own two feet whatever the circumstances," McCormick said.
